title: Build the equation the situation is already making

story.text: The gap measures 32. Your approach lip eats 12 of it and the rest is 4 deck segments.

ask.text: Close it.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Measure the far pan off the terrain, then author the near one.
The lip has eaten 12, so 4 segments have 20 left to cover.

worldFraming.text: Then you walk across what you said.

The claim closes at 47/6, and the site takes only whole members.
